SELECT m.MovieID, m.Title, m.ReleaseYear, m.Duration, m.Genre, m.Language, m.Country, m.Synopsis, (SELECT AVG(r.Score) FROM rating1707 r WHERE r.MovieID = m.MovieID) AS Rating, m.PosterUrl, m.JumpUrl, COUNT(c.CommentID) AS CommentCount,
(SELECT r.Score FROM rating1707 r WHERE r.MovieID = m.MovieID AND r.UserID = #{userId}) AS UserRating, d.DirectorID, d.Name AS DName, d.Gender AS DGender, d.BirthDate AS DBirthDate, d.Nationality AS DNationality, a.ActorID, a.Name AS AName, a.Gender AS AGender, a.BirthDate AS ABirthDate, a.Nationality AS ANationality, ma.RoleName FROM movie1707 m LEFT JOIN movie_director1707 md ON m.MovieID = md.MovieID LEFT JOIN director1707 d ON md.DirectorID = d.DirectorID LEFT JOIN movie_actor1707 ma ON m.MovieID = ma.MovieID LEFT JOIN actor1707 a ON ma.ActorID = a.ActorID LEFT JOIN comment1707 c ON m.MovieID = c.MovieID WHERE m.MovieID = #{id} GROUP BY m.MovieID, d.DirectorID, d.Name, d.Gender, d.BirthDate, d.Nationality, a.ActorID, a.Name, a.Gender, a.BirthDate, a.Nationality, ma.RoleName

SELECT m.MovieID AS movieId, m.Title AS title, m.ReleaseYear AS releaseYear, m.Duration AS duration, m.Genre AS genre, m.Language AS language, m.Country AS country, m.Synopsis AS synopsis, (SELECT AVG(r.Score) FROM rating1707 r WHERE r.MovieID = m.MovieID) AS rating, m.PosterUrl AS posterUrl, m.JumpUrl AS jumpUrl, COUNT(c.CommentID) AS CommentCount FROM movie1707 m LEFT JOIN comment1707 c ON m.MovieID = c.MovieID WHERE m.MovieID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.MovieID, m.Title, m.ReleaseYear, m.Duration, m.Genre, m.Language, m.Country, m.Synopsis, m.PosterUrl ORDER BY rating DESC, CommentCount DESC LIMIT 10
